registry_entries.name: Convert the fallen
registry_entries.summary: Your attacks or an aura tag enemy soldiers; tagged soldiers cannot be buffed, and any that die while tagged rise as weak minions on your side.

registry_entries.name: Block abilities
registry_entries.summary: An effect stops enemies from using their active and passive abilities while it lasts, but leaves them free to move and attack.

open_points: Integrator: once the five unit_links are applied, the two 'no unit links this pattern' errors clear. The Enlightened has two fit notes to remove, fit_notes/2 and fit_notes/3. The indices refer to the file as it is now, so remove both in the same pass.

Jarmen Kell's abilities/0 already links hijack-vehicle. The only change is removing fit_notes/0: his crew-kill now has its own variant, 'crew-snipe' (plus 'crew-kill-blast' for the Zero Hour neutron shells and mines). Decision: this is a variant of hijack-vehicle, not a new id, as the registry note asks. A working vehicle still changes hands, and crewless machines are still immune. Claiming the empty hull falls under the Generals game-wide recover-wreck rule. The open_questions keep the option of splitting it out if the merge pass decides the race to the neutral hull is its own interaction.

Cloak needs no unit edits: Kell abilities/1, Sentry Drone abilities/0 and Olga abilities/3 already link it. The Vimana only names pattern:cloak in counters (its Detection perk), so it gets no link and is not a source unit. Likewise the Battle Bus and the Sentry Drone touch hijack-vehicle only through matchups (bus counters/0 and countered_by/2, drone strengths/2 immune:hijack-vehicle and counters/1), so neither gets a link. The bus is immune only to the contact Hijacker while loaded; Kell's crew snipe still empties it, and the pattern's counterplay says so.

convert-on-kill is not a duplicate of mind-control: only dead units change sides, and what rises is a new, lesser unit rather than the victim. It is not leech-weapon-on-kill either, since it gains bodies, not weapons. Its aliases keep the names the fill agents used, convert-fallen-enemies and subjugate-infantry. Follow-up for the merge pass, not edited here: the Enlightened's strengths/3 hangs Subjugation on weapon:blades because no pattern existed; it could now point to pattern:convert-on-kill.

block-abilities stays a separate id from the weapon trait silence, because silence also stops firing. But silence's coding rule fires when a weapon stops firing or abilities, so an ability-only effect on a weapon (Tempest Rising's HAYWIRE missiles) could be coded as silence today. Proposed word-list fix: narrow that rule, or send ability-only blocks to this pattern. Its confidence is medium because the Tempest Rising pages never say silenced units can still attack. The Sentinel's uncertain/15 also notes that the silence belongs to the Marked status; the 'block-the-marked' variant (min_tier t3) is the proposed home for that.

The Halo Wars 2 Flood example in convert-on-kill uses game id hw2. The Flood come from the game's later content, outside the registry's standard skirmish scope. The Halo Wars 1 and 2 Spartan hijack example in hijack-vehicle uses extra:Halo Wars / Halo Wars 2.
